title: Road trip to Song-Kol
desc: You set out from Bishkek and stop first at the Burana Tower, then share a meal with a Dungan family for a taste of local home cooking and culture.
The drive carries on through Kochkor and over the Kalmak-Ashuu Pass at 3400 m before the land drops away to Song-Kol. You spend the night in a yurt on the high, quiet shore.
meals: Lunch at guesthouse, dinner at yurt

title: Ride at Song-Kol, drive to Tash-Bashat
desc: The morning brings an easy ride around Song-Kol, past yurts and grazing herds, with the option to head up into the hills if you want more time in the saddle.

In the afternoon you leave the lake, crossing the Terskey-Torpu Pass and passing through Naryn on the way to Tash-Bashat, an untouristed village where a cosy hotel and a short evening walk round off the day.
meals: Breakfast & lunch at yurt, dinner at hotel

title: Trek to hidden Kel-Suu Lake
desc: An early start sets you up for a rough, rewarding drive through the At-Bashy region and over the Kyndy Pass at 3200 m into the Kok-Kiya Valley.

From there you trek to Kel-Suu, an easy walk along a river that turns a little harder near the lake itself, where cliffs hem in startling water. There's an optional boat ride before you return to the guesthouse for dinner and the night.
meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch & dinner at guesthouse

title: Drive back to Bishkek via Ysyk-Kol
desc: The last day is mostly on the road, heading back toward Bishkek by way of Naryn along a scenic route. You stop in Kochkor for lunch and a short rest.
There's a quick look at the western end of Ysyk-Kol before the final stretch into Bishkek, closing out the trip.
meals: Breakfast at guesthouse, lunch at restaurant
